## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No content in logs (messages, prompts, titles, passphrases, keys, tokens).
- [ ] No new dependencies, or they were agreed in an issue first.
- [ ] Security-relevant changes (sign-in, sessions, invites, encryption, uploads, headers)
      have tests for the failure cases.
